description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) 'EmployeeAllowedSkillSearchFilterParams' extending a base FilterParams class. It is used to encapsulate search filter parameters related to employee allowed skills, specifically holding an employee number and specifying allowed sort fields.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedSkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Data transfer object for filtering employee allowed skills, including employee number and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used in the filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter parameters.
